name: WF1 · Stock Sync, Order Intake & Daily Digest

parameters.query:
SELECT
    merchant_id,
    name,
    zone,
    merchant_type
FROM core.merchants
WHERE active = TRUE
ORDER BY merchant_id;

INSERT INTO ops.dead_letter (
    workflow,
    node,
    execution_id,
    business_key,
    error_message,
    payload,
    attempts,
    status
)
VALUES (
    'WF1 · Stock Sync, Order Intake & Daily Digest',
    'Ambil Stok Merchant API',
    $1::text,
    $2::text,
    $3::text,
    jsonb_build_object('merchant_id', $2::text),
    3,
    'open'
)
RETURNING id, business_key, error_message, status;

SELECT
    product_id,
    sku,
    name
FROM core.products
ORDER BY product_id;

WITH previous_stock AS MATERIALIZED (
    SELECT qty AS old_qty
    FROM core.merchant_stock
    WHERE merchant_id = $1::TEXT
      AND product_id = $2::TEXT
),
updated_stock AS (
    INSERT INTO core.merchant_stock (
        merchant_id,
        product_id,
        qty,
        synced_at
    )
    VALUES (
        $1::TEXT,
        $2::TEXT,
        $3::INTEGER,
        $4::TIMESTAMPTZ
    )
    ON CONFLICT (merchant_id, product_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
        qty = EXCLUDED.qty,
        synced_at = EXCLUDED.synced_at
    RETURNING merchant_id, product_id, qty, synced_at
)
SELECT
    u.*,
    (
        COALESCE((SELECT old_qty FROM previous_stock), 0) > 0
        AND u.qty = 0
    ) AS is_new_stockout
FROM updated_stock u;

INSERT INTO ops.sync_runs (
    merchants_total,
    merchants_ok,
    rows_synced,
    new_stockouts,
    duration_ms
)
VALUES (
    $1::INTEGER,
    $2::INTEGER,
    $3::INTEGER,
    $5::INTEGER,
    GREATEST(
        0,
        EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (
            NOW() - $4::TIMESTAMPTZ
        )) * 1000
    )::INTEGER
)
RETURNING *;

parameters.query:
WITH order_input AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS payload
),
requested_items AS (
    SELECT
        UPPER(item->>'sku') AS sku,
        (item->>'qty')::INTEGER AS requested_qty
    FROM order_input,
    jsonb_array_elements(payload->'items') AS item
),
stock_check AS (
    SELECT
        r.sku,
        r.requested_qty,
        p.product_id,
        COALESCE(s.qty, 0) AS available_qty
    FROM requested_items r
    LEFT JOIN core.products p
        ON UPPER(p.sku) = r.sku
    LEFT JOIN core.merchant_stock s
        ON s.product_id = p.product_id
        AND s.merchant_id = $2::TEXT
)
SELECT
    $3::TEXT AS order_id,
    $2::TEXT AS merchant_id,
    COUNT(*) AS total_items,
    COUNT(*) FILTER (
        WHERE product_id IS NULL
           OR available_qty < requested_qty
    ) AS insufficient_items,
    CASE
        WHEN COUNT(*) = 0 THEN 'invalid'
        WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE product_id IS NULL
               OR available_qty < requested_qty
        ) > 0 THEN 'habis'
        WHEN COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE available_qty - requested_qty <= 5
        ) > 0 THEN 'tipis'
        ELSE 'cukup'
    END AS stock_status,
    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'sku', sku,
                'requested_qty', requested_qty,
                'available_qty', available_qty
            )
        ) FILTER (WHERE sku IS NOT NULL),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS stock_details
FROM stock_check;

WITH payload AS (
    SELECT $1::JSONB AS data
),
inserted_order AS (
    INSERT INTO core.orders (
        order_id,
        customer_id,
        merchant_id,
        zone,
        order_date,
        created_at,
        status,
        cancel_reason,
        total_amount,
        payment_status,
        customer_note
    )
    SELECT
        p.data->>'order_id',
        p.data->>'customer_id',
        p.data->>'merchant_id',
        m.zone,
        (NOW() AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Jakarta')::DATE,
        NOW(),
        'active',
        NULL,
        (p.data->>'total_amount')::NUMERIC,
        'unpaid',
        p.data->>'customer_note'
    FROM payload p
    JOIN core.merchants m
      ON m.merchant_id = p.data->>'merchant_id'
    ON CONFLICT (order_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING order_id, status
),
inserted_items AS (
    INSERT INTO core.order_items (
        order_id,
        product_id,
        qty,
        unit_price
    )
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        prod.product_id,
        (item.value->>'qty')::INTEGER,
        prod.price
    FROM inserted_order o
    CROSS JOIN payload p
    CROSS JOIN LATERAL
        jsonb_array_elements(p.data->'items') AS item(value)
    JOIN core.products prod
      ON UPPER(prod.sku) = UPPER(item.value->>'sku')
    ON CONFLICT (order_id, product_id) DO NOTHING
    RETURNING product_id
)
SELECT
    p.data->>'order_id' AS order_id,
    COALESCE(
        (SELECT status FROM inserted_order LIMIT 1),
        (
            SELECT status
            FROM core.orders
            WHERE order_id = p.data->>'order_id'
        )
    ) AS status,
    EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM inserted_order
    ) AS created,
    NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1 FROM inserted_order
    ) AS already_exists,
    (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM inserted_items
    ) AS items_saved,
    $2::TEXT AS stock_status
FROM payload p;

parameters.query:
WITH tanggal_acuan AS (
    SELECT hari_data_terakhir AS tanggal
    FROM core.data_info
    LIMIT 1
),
order_harian AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.status,
        d.actual_minutes
    FROM core.orders o
    LEFT JOIN core.deliveries d
        ON d.order_id = o.order_id
    CROSS JOIN tanggal_acuan t
    WHERE o.order_date = t.tanggal
),
kpi AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(*) AS total_orders,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
        ) AS cancelled_orders,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'delivered'
              AND actual_minutes IS NOT NULL
        ) AS delivered_orders,
        COUNT(*) FILTER (
            WHERE status = 'delivered'
              AND actual_minutes <= 30
        ) AS on_time_orders
    FROM order_harian
)
SELECT
    t.tanggal AS tanggal_digest,
    k.total_orders,
    k.cancelled_orders,
    COALESCE(
        ROUND(
            100.0 * k.cancelled_orders /
            NULLIF(k.total_orders, 0),
            2
        ),
        0
    ) AS cancel_rate_pct,
    k.delivered_orders,
    k.on_time_orders,
    COALESCE(
        ROUND(
            100.0 * k.on_time_orders /
            NULLIF(k.delivered_orders, 0),
            2
        ),
        0
    ) AS sla_30m_pct
FROM tanggal_acuan t
CROSS JOIN kpi k;

parameters.query:
WITH alasan AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(cancel_reason, 'tidak_diketahui') AS alasan_batal,
        COUNT(*) AS jumlah_pembatalan
    FROM core.orders
    WHERE order_date = $1::DATE
      AND status = 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY COALESCE(cancel_reason, 'tidak_diketahui')
    ORDER BY jumlah_pembatalan DESC, alasan_batal
    LIMIT 5
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        jsonb_agg(
            jsonb_build_object(
                'alasan_batal', alasan_batal,
                'jumlah_pembatalan', jumlah_pembatalan
            )
            ORDER BY jumlah_pembatalan DESC, alasan_batal
        ),
        '[]'::jsonb
    ) AS alasan_batal
FROM alasan;
